errors.text: The hypothesis assumes a single-phase or metastable FCC alloy, whereas the target is a lamellar FCC/B2 eutectic alloy whose brittleness originates primarily from incoherent phase interfaces.
The proposed cold-rolling and partial-recrystallization route does not reconstruct the decisive 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT treatment.
Its stated boundary condition concedes that the strategy may fail in alloys containing persistent brittle B2 phases, which directly describes the target system.
The proposed back-stress and twinning mechanism omits the target mechanism of pressure-induced coherent FCC/B2 interfaces and preferential dislocation transfer between phases.
